cases.prompt: Cloud Run 的 minimum instances 如何計費？請附官方來源。
assertions: Uses search_documents before making a version-sensitive claim.
Uses get_documents when search snippets do not establish billing detail.
Includes an official Google source URL or retrieved document URI.

cases.prompt: 比較 Cloud Run 與 Cloud Functions 適合新 HTTP microservice 的情境。
assertions: May use answer_query for a concise synthesis.
On answer_query timeout, 429, or insufficient references, falls back to search_documents plus get_documents.
Does not claim an unverified grounded answer after a failed answer_query call.

cases.prompt: 這個環境沒有名為 bifrost 的 MCP server，如何查 Firebase Android 13 POST_NOTIFICATIONS 文件？
assertions: Discovers a healthy server by Google Developer Knowledge tool capability rather than a fixed alias.
Reports whether it used MCP, REST, or an official-document fallback and why.
Reports whether each configured candidate timed out, was offline, or lacked required tools when discovery fails.
Does not hardcode an environment-specific server name or credentials.

cases.prompt: answer_query 收到 429 但沒有 Retry-After 時，如何繼續查 Cloud Run quota 文件？
assertions: Waits one second and retries answer_query no more than once.
Falls back to search_documents plus get_documents after the bounded retry fails.
Reports the fallback instead of claiming answer_query succeeded.

cases.prompt: MCP 回傳 403，且沒有 DEVELOPERKNOWLEDGE_API_KEY；我要查 Firebase App Check 文件。
assertions: Stops retrying after the authentication or authorization failure.
Does not issue a REST request without an API key.
Uses an official-document fallback and discloses the reason.

cases.prompt: 沒有可用 MCP，但有 OAuth access token 和 quota project；查 Cloud Run minimum instances 計費並附來源。
assertions: Uses the REST OAuth fallback with an Authorization header and x-goog-user-project header.
Retrieves no more than three parent documents unless broad extraction was explicitly requested.
Reports a retrieval record with method, fallback reason, sources, and verification level.
